caption.text: Part 2 of NODE MODULE RESOLUTION. Every 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' you have ever hit comes from one of three decisions Node makes before your code runs: which parser, which path, which copy. This handbook walks the actual CJS probing order and the ESM URL rules, then the package.json fields — type, exports, imports — that steer both. Ends with the dual-package hazard and the debug commands that print exactly what won.
